name: Dire Wolf Alpha

abilities.name: Howl of the Pack
abilities.description: Calls forth spectral under-wolves to shield the alpha, absorbing up to 25% incoming damage.

abilities.name: Crippling Bite
abilities.description: Applies a permanent 15% movement and armor debuff to the target legion.

rally_recommendations: Ensure at least one defensive tank legion to hold the Alpha while Cavalry legions flank from the sides.

name: Great Cave Bear

abilities.name: Tectonic Slam
abilities.description: Crushes the ground, dealing massive area-of-effect physical damage and stunning all legions within 10 meters for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Thick Hide
abilities.description: Passively reduces all standard physical attack damage by 30% when below half health.

rally_recommendations: Use Ranged legions to safely pelt the Bear while avoiding its front tectonic shockwave zone.

name: Crystal Spider Queen

abilities.name: Web Spit
abilities.description: Ensnaring web lines trap the fastest moving legion, disabling active skill usage for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Crystal Venom
abilities.description: Injects toxic shards that explode on expiry, transferring the poison to adjacent friendly legions.

rally_recommendations: Cavalry speed is crucial to dodge poison spouts. Coordinate quick disengagements when targeted by the venom.

name: Stone Troll Chieftain

abilities.name: Ruinous Boulder
abilities.description: Hurls a colossal stone boulder at the rally leader, split-sharing damage with all adjacent allies.

abilities.name: Chieftain's Fury
abilities.description: Increases attack speed by 2% for every 1% health lost, building into a devastating frenzy.

rally_recommendations: Form a tightly-grouped defensive block of Infantry to split-share the damage of the Ruinous Boulder.

name: Ancient Griffin

abilities.name: Tempest Sweep
abilities.description: Summons micro-tornadoes that scatter legions across the arena, breaking rally channel formations.

abilities.name: Gilded Plume Burst
abilities.description: Launches sharp razor-feathers, applying 35% armor reduction to the primary target.

rally_recommendations: Deploy net traps and long-range ballista archers to force the Griffin out of flight phase.

name: Ancient Crystal Dragon

abilities.name: Prismatic Breath
abilities.description: Breathes a continuous cone of cosmic crystal fire, transforming struck troops into static crystal columns.

abilities.name: Supernova Shell
abilities.description: Channels a world-shattering crystal shield. Must be broken within 15 seconds, or the ensuing shockwave wipes all raiders.

rally_recommendations: A maximum-size balanced alliance rally is required. Save ultimate skills to shatter the Supernova Shell instantly.
